content: We demonstrate a general model but we also realize that there can be other variants of it which may be worked out to perform better. Our approach consists of using element wise difference between two vectors followed by a linear transformation to produce a scalar weight. The remaining of the process acts similar to how attention works. Mathematically, we can express it as: DISPLAYFORM0
